False positive in this test executable's replacement allocation functions. operator new/new[] delegate to this raw-storage allocation routine, and all matching ordinary scalar/array/sized delete replacements call std::free. The new-expression still constructs objects and the delete-expression still destroys them; malloc is used only for the underlying storage layer. Replacing this malloc with new or a container would recursively invoke the same replacement allocator. Zero-size allocation is normalized and allocation failure follows the new_handler/bad_alloc protocol. The C++ allocation specification permits this implementation, and libstdc++ GCC 13 uses the same malloc/free storage pairing in new_op.cc/del_op.cc.
References: https://eel.is/c++draft/new.delete.single ; https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/blob/releases/gcc-13.4.0/libstdc%2B%2B-v3/libsupc%2B%2B/new_op.cc ; https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/blob/releases/gcc-13.4.0/libstdc%2B%2B-v3/libsupc%2B%2B/del_op.cc

False positive: CompletionAllocationApp creates an EditorFrame as a wxApp-managed top-level window. The AfterPresentation callback calls frame->Destroy() after success and caught test failure. Pinned wxWidgets 3.3.3 wxTopLevelWindowBase::Destroy queues deletion, wxAppConsoleBase::DeletePendingObjects deletes queued windows, and wxAppBase cleanup deletes remaining top-level windows. The new expression participates in this framework ownership protocol; adding an independent smart pointer would introduce conflicting ownership.
References: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/src/common/toplvcmn.cpp ; https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/src/common/appbase.cpp ; https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/src/common/appcmn.cpp

False positive: this lambda passes root.data() into WordList::Init. root is a local constexpr std::array<char, 4>; taking its data pointer odr-uses the local array storage, so the reference capture is required. The callback executes synchronously while root remains alive. A C++23 compiler check of this expression succeeds with [&root] and fails with [] ('root is not captured'). Removing the capture as recommended makes the source ill-formed. The padded array also preserves the four-byte cached sort-key precondition used by production CharBuffer storage.

Portability false positive at tests/completion_allocation.cpp:212 (PR 219 analysis revision bc6ea68). The shared/Linux source is built with the supported GCC 13 baseline selected by .github/actions/dependencies/action.yml (gcc-13/g++-13 and CC/CXX). GCC's official libstdc++ status table records P2093R14/std::print as first available in GCC 14.1, so the recommended <print> API is absent from the supported standard library. Retain the existing printf-family diagnostic.
